name: Excelsior Medical Co., Ltd.
summary: Excelsior Medical Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the sale of medical supplies and equipment, medicines, and home medical devices in Taiwan, Hong Kong, China, the Philippines, Malaysia, and Indonesia. It operates through Excelsior, Dynamic, Arich, and Other segments. The company offers hemodialysis/plasma exchange; blood bags; artificial stomas; and health appliances. It is also involved in the sale, maintenance, and lease of laser medical equipment for beauty treatment; sale of beauty treatment and cosmetic products, precision instrument, real estate, lifestyle beauty products and treatments, medical beauty products; manufacture of medical equipment; provision of logis…
